entry.title: Abercrombie & Fitch Co.: Entered riskiest 5%
entry.summary: Bankruptcy risk entered the riskiest 5%: riskier than 95% of filers with the 10-K filed 2021-03-29 (was 82%).

entry.title: Abercrombie & Fitch Co.: Restatement notice
entry.summary: Filed an 8-K under Item 4.02: previously issued financial statements should no longer be relied on.

entry.title: Abercrombie & Fitch Co.: Risk jump
entry.summary: Bankruptcy risk rose from riskier than 50% to 89% of filers with the 10-Q filed 2020-06-10.

entry.title: Abercrombie & Fitch Co.: Going-concern wording
entry.summary: The new 10-K says events "raise substantial doubt" (going-concern wording); the previous 10-K did not.
